body: For a configuration-lifecycle task, bind the selected module entry and actual stage source. Independently observe creation, application-context environment registration, language change, color-mode change and destruction. Require the accepted source to pass and wrong-entry/wrong-event mutations to fail their declared intended checks. Read raw worker observations rather than trusting startup completion or producer booleans. These verified controls cover only the recorded operator-dispatch source seam; separately calibrate actual framework delivery, ArkTS/HAP, exact emulator API and ohosTest before qualifying the task.
title: A startup-only observation does not establish configuration delivery through the selected stage

body: When repairing this frozen ApplicationContext subscription extension, track whether a callback is owned independently of callback ID truthiness. The task explicitly permits ID zero; this is not an upstream API guarantee. Acquire local ownership only after registration succeeds, allow retry after failure, and release ownership on destruction so recreation can register again. Repeated creation may retain or replace the owned callback but must not accumulate subscriptions. Destruction before creation and repeated destruction must not cancel an invalid callback. Preserve the original configuration and memory logging and prevent delivery after destruction. Check both accepted retain-owned and replace-owned implementations against zero-ID, stale-owner and duplicate-subscription negative controls. This lesson is supported by reconstructed controlled host-seam observations, not formal ArkTS build, platform lifecycle dispatch, HAP, emulator, ohosTest, authenticated producer identity, or measured learning benefit. It describes a new task extension, not an upstream defect.
title: Repeated creation, destruction, recreation and registration failure distinguish subscription ownership implementations

body: Calibrate RatingDescriptor.convert against the exact frozen source under declared controlled defaults and an identity Observed decorator. Construct a fresh instance for each scenario and assert rating=0, indicator=false, stars=5, stepSize=0.5 and starStyle=false from actual own fields before convert. Read attributes from scenarioInputs, not a duplicated action list. Observe actual post-call fields and undefined return; encode actual NaN as a disclosed tagged value. Retain passing behavior-preserving variants, wrong rating assignment, wrong indicator comparison and wrong stars assignment with exact failure sets and reference recovery. This evidence qualifies only the four tested source-seam scenarios, not real decorators, parent/mapping implementations, framework rendering, Harmony build/runtime or a formal Agent case.
